# Knobbe Martens

> > A leading national intellectual property and technology law firm with 300+ professionals specializing in patent litigation, trademark law, and trade secret protection across major U.S. innovation centers.

Knobbe Martens is a premier IP law firm with deep expertise in patent prosecution, litigation, and technology law serving Fortune 500 companies and innovative startups. The firm maintains a strong track record of high-value verdicts and settlements in patent and antitrust litigation, particularly in the medical device and biotech sectors.

## Key Topics

- Patent Litigation
- Intellectual Property Law
- Trade Secrets
- Patent Strategy
- Trademark Law
- Technology Law
- PTAB (Patent Trial and Appeal Board)
- Medical Device IP
- Biotech & Gene Therapy
- FDA Regulatory Strategy
- Antitrust Litigation
- Trade Secret Litigation
- IP Prosecution
- Firm Recognition
- Diversity & Inclusion
